classification.difficultyReason: Use the equilateral condition to choose two independent equalities between three side expressions, simplify them, and solve the resulting linear system. The representation change requires a routine modelling decision.

content.prompt: The diagram below shows an equilateral triangle with unknown side lengths. Find $x$ and $y$.

spec.description: Upright equilateral triangle with a horizontal base, one equality tick on each edge and exterior double-ended dimension arrows. Sloping expressions follow their corresponding sides.
spec.mathematics: All three side expressions are equal. Left side 3x+2y, right side 2x+y+1, base 6y-3x.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied side expressions and equality marks are visible.

answer.worked:
The sides of an equilateral triangle are equal.
$$\begin{align*}3x+2y&=2x+y+1\\x+y&=1\\3x+2y&=6y-3x\\6x&=4y\\y&=\frac32x\end{align*}$$
Substitute into $x+y=1$.
$$\begin{align*}x+\frac32x&=1\\\frac52x&=1\\x&=\frac25\\y&=\frac32\times\frac25\\y&=\frac35\end{align*}$$
Each side then has length $\frac{12}{5}$.
